<view class="checkbox-tree {{extClass}}">
  <view
    wx:for="{{flatNodes}}"
    wx:key="id"
    class="checkbox-tree-item"
    style="padding-left: {{item.level * 20}}rpx;"
    data-id="{{item.id}}"
    bindtap="onToggle"
  >
    <checkbox checked="{{checkedMap[item.id]}}" disabled="{{item.disabled}}" />
    <text class="checkbox-tree-label">{{item.label}}</text>
  </view>
</view>
